info.title: 3DS-CLI
info.author: cmdada
info.description: Run RISCV Linux on Nintendo consoles!
info.details:
3DS-CLI boots a stock RV32 Linux 6.6 kernel with a glibc userspace off your SD card, using mini-rv32ima-mmu.

Controls:
Button 	Action
L / Y 	Zoom out
R / X 	Zoom in
ZL 	Toggle auto-follow cursor
ZR 	Toggle font (8x8 / 5x7 compact)
Circle Pad 	Pan the viewport (turns off auto-follow)
D-Pad 	Arrow keys
START 	Quit to the Homebrew Launcher
SELECT 	Open settings menu, it's pretty self explanatory
Key 	Action
SHF 	Shift (uppercase)
?#1 / #+= 	Symbol layers
ABC 	Back to letters
CTL 	Ctrl modifier. Tap CTL, then a letter
TAB / ESC / ENT / DEL 	Tab, escape, enter, backspace

changelog: V4.0: Added support for the Wii U, Wii, Gamecube, and Switch!
